coverage:
Git history of 5 repos. Four came from live hub clones in substrate-live:/workspace/git/vessels: ias-executor-ts (218 commits, HEAD 700ceff 09-28), boredom-vessel (134, HEAD 12bb26a 09-28), concept-db (122, HEAD d844020 09-28) and obsidian-vessel (371, HEAD 1bd0226 08-22). workbench (213, HEAD e045a2d 05-24) came from host repos/, since no live clone exists. Node 2 (compose2-live) HEADs were checked and match the hub for all four live repos, so no node divergence was found in this shard. Host submodules lag (ias 25150c9, boredom 36954f2, concept-db 9e2c8a8).

What I read: all operator commit subjects, about 45 operator commit bodies, numstat for every autonomous commit, and about 30 autonomous diffs. Pickaxe (-S) searches covered gaps.json, body.gaps, edit_site, posterior, EXECUTABLE_RESOLVERS, resolve_endpoint, spendEnvelope, confabulat, interpolateBoundValues and concept-relevance-backfill-v2. I also checked super-repo gitlink ancestry (c0e42fa3), live systemd units and timers for these vessels, and Bun's .ts-vs-.js resolution with one scratch test on the host.

SKIPPED: workbench diffs (subjects only). About 180 of the 187 July obsidian autonomous diffs (numstat only). Boredom June/July unknown-proposal index.ts churn (e.g. 3b422bf +95/-134). Concept-db July autonomous diffs (sql/core 007/008, decontaminate). Gap-store and DB records for the named gap ids were not queried.

principles: An explicit projection is a silent dropper by construction; adding a field produces no error (ias 9518d4e)
An instruction naming a field that does not exist is worse than no instruction (ias f71bb56)
Show the correct output beside the incorrect one; prohibition alone has a poor record (ias 5030377)
The category was never evidence; predicate on the claim itself (boredom 7868111)
Behaviour gated behind an in-process constant can never be found wanting because it is never attempted (boredom 92f3336, substrate-authored)
A judge verifying that a patch CHANGES the named behaviour is not verifying it does what was asked (obsidian b1d2417)
A wrong edit_site is strictly worse than none (obsidian 968d693)
Run the lookup against live data rather than trusting a clean typecheck; proceed on absence of evidence (boredom 4e17f86)
A liveness ping can report healthy through a total capability outage (concept-db cb400d6)
When fixing a class, grep sibling call sites, but also re-run the consumer (fd645bd followed that principle and still broke recall for 24 days)
Landing is not deploying: Obsidian loads a BUILT main.js (obsidian aa4ae90)
A consumer of a shared table must not define it (concept-db 9b5c087)
Grade the outcome event, not the dispatch/deadline proxy (boredom fb2e5f0, 59ac3cf)
A siteless gap should yield investigate/decompose, not a Close goal (boredom 12bb26a, substrate-authored)
